aboutTitle: A trusted exchange, built in Afghanistan.
aboutLead: Aryana Currency is a licensed digital currency exchange focused on making USDT ↔ AFN trading clear, safe and accessible for everyone.
aboutStoryText1: Aryana Currency was founded with a simple goal: give people in Afghanistan a trustworthy, modern way to exchange digital currency. For years, the market has been informal, rates have been unclear, and trust has been hard to find.
aboutStoryText2: We wanted to change that. Our platform is designed around transparency, security, and a straightforward customer experience — from the rate you see, to the moment the funds arrive.
aboutValue1Text: Every rate, every fee, every step — shown clearly before you commit. No hidden charges, no surprises.
aboutValue2Text: Funds are held in secure, segregated wallets. Every payment is manually verified by our team before completion.
aboutValue3Text: We operate under a valid official license, follow KYC/AML best practices, and maintain a full audit trail of every transaction.
aboutValue4Text: Real humans, real support. Whether it's your first exchange or your hundredth, we treat every customer with the same care.
aboutLicenseBoxText: Aryana Currency operates under an officially-issued license for digital currency exchange. License details are available upon request. For verification, contact us at the email below.
aboutHowText: We operate a manual-verified model. When you place an order:
aboutHowStep1: You send the funds (AFN via Hesab Pay, or USDT via Tron network).
aboutHowStep2: You submit the transaction reference in your dashboard.
aboutHowStep3: Our team verifies the payment — usually within minutes.
aboutHowStep4: We send the equivalent funds to your account.
aboutHowNote: This manual step is intentional. It's how we protect both you and the platform from fraud.
aboutContactText: Have questions? We're here to help.
contactLead: Questions about an order, your account, or the platform? Reach out — our team responds as fast as possible.
faq1Q: How long does an order take?
faq1A: Most orders are verified within a few minutes during business hours. In busy periods, it may take up to 2 hours. You can track the status in your dashboard.
faq3A: A flat 1.5% platform fee applies to every completed order. No hidden charges.
faq4Q: Which network do you use for USDT?
faq4A: We currently support USDT on the TRC20 (Tron) network for fast, low-cost transfers.
faq5A: Yes. Funds are held in secure wallets, every payment is manually verified, and all transactions are logged in a double-entry ledger for a complete audit trail.
contactBoxText: Never share your password or account recovery codes with anyone. Our team will never ask for them.
privacyLead: How Aryana Currency collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
privacySummaryText: We collect only what we need to operate the exchange, verify your identity, and protect your account. We never sell your data. We never share it except when required by law.
privacy1Text: We collect the following types of information:
privacy1Item1: Account data: name, email address, phone number, password (hashed).
privacy1Item2: Payment data: Hesab Pay number, USDT wallet address, transaction references.
privacy1Item3: Transaction data: orders, amounts, timestamps, and status history.
privacy1Item4: KYC data (when applicable): identity documents you upload for verification.
privacy1Item5: Technical data: IP address, browser type, and access times for security purposes.
privacy2Text: We use your information only for the following purposes:
privacy2Item1: To operate your account and process orders.
privacy2Item2: To verify your identity (KYC) as required by law.
privacy2Item3: To prevent fraud, money laundering, and unauthorized access.
privacy2Item4: To communicate with you about your account or orders.
privacy2Item5: To comply with legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy3Text: We take security seriously. Our protections include:
privacy3Item1: Passwords are hashed with industry-standard bcrypt — never stored in plain text.
privacy3Item3: Sessions use short-lived JWT tokens with refresh rotation.
privacy3Item4: Access to customer data is restricted and logged.
privacy3Item5: Funds are held in secure, segregated wallets.
privacy4Text: We do not sell your personal data. We only share information in the following cases:
privacy4Item1: With regulatory authorities, when legally required.
privacy4Item2: With service providers essential to operating the platform (hosting, database), under strict confidentiality agreements.
privacy4Item3: With your explicit consent, for any other purpose.
privacy5Text: We retain your account and transaction data for as long as your account is active, and for the period required by applicable law after that (typically 5 years for financial records).
privacy6Item1: Access the personal data we hold about you.
privacy6Item3: Request deletion of your account (subject to legal retention requirements).
privacy6Item4: Contact us with any privacy-related concern.
privacy7Text: We use browser local storage to keep you logged in and to remember your language and theme preferences. We do not use third-party tracking cookies.
privacy8Text: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be announced on the platform. Continued use of the service means you accept the updated policy.
privacy9Text: For any privacy-related questions or requests, contact us at:

riskLead: Important information you should understand before trading digital currency.
riskWarningText: Trading digital currencies involves significant risk. Only trade with funds you can afford to lose.
risk1Text: The value of digital currencies such as Tether (USDT) and traditional currencies such as the Afghan Afghani (AFN) can fluctuate significantly. You may gain or lose money as a result of these fluctuations.
risk2Text: Cryptocurrency transfers occur on public blockchains. Risks include:
risk2Item1: Sending funds to the wrong address — these transactions are irreversible.
risk2Item2: Choosing the wrong network (e.g., sending TRC20 USDT to an ERC20 address) — funds may be permanently lost.
risk2Item3: Network congestion leading to delays or higher fees.
risk3Text: AFN payments are made via Hesab Pay. You are responsible for:
risk3Item1: Ensuring the account details you provide are correct.
risk3Item2: Keeping your Hesab Pay account secure.
risk3Item3: Verifying the recipient before sending funds.
risk4Text: The legal status of digital currencies varies by country and may change. It is your responsibility to understand and comply with the laws of your jurisdiction.
risk5Text: Every order is manually verified. If we cannot verify your payment reference, your order may be delayed, rejected, or refunded.
risk6Text: Like any online platform, we may occasionally experience downtime, bugs, or service interruptions. While we work hard to prevent this, we cannot guarantee uninterrupted service.
risk7Text: Nothing on this platform constitutes investment advice. All trading decisions are yours alone. We do not recommend buying or selling any particular asset.
risk8Item1: Always double-check wallet addresses before sending.
risk8Item2: Use the correct network for your transfer.
risk8Item3: Start with small amounts until you're comfortable.
risk8Item5: Contact our support if anything seems unclear.
risk9Text: By using Aryana Currency, you acknowledge that you have read and understood these risks and accept full responsibility for your trading decisions.
